prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity desktop web application UI mockup, 1536 by 1024, front-on full viewport. No device frame. Product Outdoor OS combines trails, gear, trip planning, GPS activities. Direction C: Trip planner. The trip itself is the centerpiece, with simple preparation tools. Extremely polished modern product interface.
STRUCTURE: a 220px solid dark evergreen #173f35 left navigation rail, small white mountain icon and 'Outdoor OS' wordmark at top. Rail labels with restrained outline icons: Overview, Explore, My trips (selected slightly lighter green field), Gear. Near bottom 'Record activity' outlined light button and Profile. Main canvas #f6f7f4 with 48px inset margins. Top horizontal utility row 'My trips' left, 'New trip' green button right. Main title 'Teton Crest Trail', small 'Example trip · Preview' inline beside title, below 'Wyoming, USA'. Under title, a shallow wide landscape photography banner 220px tall showing an alpine mountain valley, with a simple white overlay strip bottom containing '40 mi', '4 days', 'Dates to decide', and small 'Edit trip' link. Below banner an understated three-stage horizontal strip with '1 Choose a trail' completed check, '2 Prepare your pack' active, '3 Record your outing' next. Below this two-column task area: 65% white packing checklist pane headed 'Your packing list' and '+ Add gear'; small '3 of 6 items packed' progress line, tidy six rows with checkbox, item name, muted category: 'Lightweight tent' Shelter checked, 'Sleeping bag' Sleep system checked, 'Water filter' Hydration checked, 'Food for 4 days' Consumables unchecked, 'Warm layers' Clothing unchecked, 'First aid kit' Essentials unchecked. 35% right plain lightly tinted summary column with 'Ready when you are.', concise paragraph 'A place for your route, your gear, and the miles ahead.', green 'Record this hike' button, secondary 'Download checklist', small note 'Plan saved on this device'. Checklist mock data explicitly covered by Example trip Preview label. Do not invent personal achievements, ratings, safety guidance or totals.
STYLE: clean confident sans typography, white/light mineral workspace, deep evergreen rail, forest green primary buttons, crisp charcoal text, thin neutral dividers, 12px rounding, no shadows except extremely soft header, no glass, gradients, neon, serif or extra decoration. Generous but workmanlike spacing. The landscape banner is the only photo. Clear active task, accessible contrast, crisp correctly spelled text, light and dark beautifully balanced. Deliver a compelling implementable app UI.
approvalNote: User selected fieldbook via the mockup comparison page (955879e8). Whole-app visual implementation remains a separate scope from the catalog extension.
